facts.event: Tilde 抵达 Faoldun 城中，只见约三十名 Merogians 聚集，认出 Ardwen 的铜饰、Hallion 的红长靴、Kanaan 的银耳环、Falcan 的铁胸针与 Gevera 的蓝织线。
facts.relation: Tilde 与散居各城的 Merogian 遗民
facts.anchor: There were thirty, at most. I saw the bronze and brass adornments of Ardwen

facts.event: 人群围住 Tilde，连声唤她 Queen Tilde、Rivani 之女、森林之子并求她救命；她先答“我来帮忙”，随即改口宣布“我来解放你们”，要众人耐心退开。
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Faoldun 平民（被围困者）
facts.anchor: ‘I am here to free you! Be patient, and leave me to this work.’

facts.event: Marolyn 拨开抓住 Tilde 的手、伸臂将她环住护在身前，走在前头的 Guwetha 回头才发现两人掉队。
facts.relation: Marolyn 对 Tilde 的护卫关系（贴身保护）
facts.anchor: Marolyn brushed some hands off, her arms coming around me as Guwetha looked back

facts.event: Guwetha 领众人走向要塞外郭与门楼前一字排开的七座仓库；其中三座已被烧毁，另一座留着点火未成的焦痕。
facts.relation: Guwetha 作为向导带领 Tilde 一行
facts.anchor: following her towards the seven warehouses that stood all in a row

facts.event: 第五座酒库被改作伤兵营：一名女子被按在桌上、口中塞着木棍，医生正从膝部截去她发黑发臭的腿，助手随后舀酒浇洗伤口、商人记账却未阻拦。
facts.relation: Guwetha 与伤兵营众人（她刻意让 Tilde 看代价）
facts.numbers: removing her leg at the knee
facts.anchor: a physik went to work removing her leg at the knee

facts.event: Guwetha 说明是 Yoldan 召出了那道墙——他是除她之外仅有的两名通晓 Ways 的 druidim 之一，如今心智迷失在 Ways 里；他自把双臂浸入沸油献祭以护住众人。
facts.relation: Guwetha 与 Yoldan（同门 druidim，疑似旧情人）
facts.anchor: ‘Yoldan summoned the wall,’ said Guwetha. ‘He is one of two other druidim who know the Ways

facts.event: Yoldan 半撑起身大喊“Six lands united!”，Tilde 认出这正是荆棘墙发声时的那个嗓音——墙的声音本是他给的形状。
facts.relation: Yoldan 与荆棘墙（他的声音成为墙的voice）
facts.anchor: I recognised his voice, it was the voice the thorn wall spoke with

facts.event: Tilde 指出 Guwetha 六年前就在 Sanafin 出事现场，Guwetha 点头承认“我当时在场”。
facts.relation: Guwetha 与 Tilde／Sanafin 六年前的旧事
facts.anchor: ‘You were there,’ I said. ‘Six years ago.’
